entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I received. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your full name and order number?
Sure, the name is Samuel Chen, and the order number is VF9872-05.

Thank you, Samuel. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 16th. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, it was something of an impulse buy for a New Year's resolution. I've realized I just don't use it, and I've changed my mind about keeping it. I know I'm a couple of weeks out, so I was wondering what my options might be.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying that. Let me just review the return eligibility for your item. Please hold for a moment.
Alright, thank you for your patience, Samuel. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the return window. We have a 90-day return period for our products.
Oh, really? 90 days? I was expecting it to be much shorter. That's great news.

Yes, absolutely. Since it's only been about 18 days, we can go ahead and process a full refund for you. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Do you still have the original packaging?
I do, yes. This is much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you.

You're very welcome. Just place the band back in the box, attach that label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse logs the return, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's everything. I appreciate your help, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
